detail.title: Provisional Analysis: CRASH Agent Architecture and Industrial Generalizability
detail.summary: Adapting CRASH agents for industrial safety requires bridging the gap between narrative-based incident reporting (RO-ILS) and broader industrial domain knowledge. Integrating unstructured knowledge editing (CAKE) offers a path to update the agent's safety priors without requiring full retraining, though the fidelity of causal attribution in unstructured reports remains unverified.
detail.reason: Adapting CRASH methodologies using unstructured knowledge editing.
